azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message contains "[EMD][PAYMENT][SAVE-RETRIEVAL] Saved retrieval"
| extend 
    retrievalId = extract(@"Saved retrieval:\s*([^ ]+)", 1, Message),
    pspDenomination = extract(@"pspDenomination:\s*([^,]+)", 1, Message),
    entityId = extract(@"entityId:\s*([^, ]+)", 1, Message),
    tppId = extract(@"tppId:\s*([^, ]+)", 1, Message),
    agent = extract(@"agent:\s*([^, ]+)", 1, Message),
    deepLink = extract(@"deepLink:\s*([^ ]+)", 1, Message),
    originId = extract(@"originId:\s*([^, ]+)", 1, Message),
    payment = extract(@"isPaymentEnabled:\s*([^, ]+)", 1, Message),
    createdAt = extract(@"createdAt:\s*(.+)$", 1, Message)
| extend zw = unicode_codepoints_to_string(8203)
| extend deepLink = replace_regex(deepLink, @"([/?&=])", "\\1\u200b")
| where ('$originId' == '' or originId == '$originId')
| where ('$tppId' == '' or tppId == '$tppId')
| project TimeGenerated, createdAt, retrievalId, pspDenomination, entityId, tppId, originId, deepLink, payment, agent
| order by TimeGenerated desc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let targetMessageId = "${messageId}";
let targetEntityId = "${entityId}";
let map = datatable(State: string, Label: string, Status: string)
    [
    "RECEIVED", "Ricevimento messaggio da SEND", "INFO",
    "ADD_KAFKA", "Aggiunto a coda invio messaggi", "INFO",
    "START_PROCESSING", "Elaborazione messaggio", "INFO",
    "RETRY_PROCESSING", "Nuovo tentativo di elaborazione programmato", "INFO",
    "PROCESSING_FAILED", "Elaborazione fallita: esauriti i tentativi", "FAILURE",
    "TRY_SEND_PSP", "Tentativo di invio al PSP", "INFO",
    "TRY_TOKEN_FAILED", "Fallita autenticazione PSP", "FAILURE",
    "SENT_FAILED", "Invio messaggio fallito", "FAILURE",
    "RETRY_EXHAUSTED", "Esauriti i tentativi di invio alla PSP", "FAILURE",
    "SENT_SUCCESS", "Messaggio consegnato al PSP", "SUCCESS"
];
let allLogs = union
    (AppTraces
        | project TimeGenerated, Message, SeverityLevel, AppRoleName, OperationId),
    (AppExceptions
        | extend Message = coalesce(tostring(Properties["Logger Message"]), OuterMessage)
        | project TimeGenerated, Message, SeverityLevel, AppRoleName, OperationId);
let targetOpId = toscalar(
    AppTraces
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Message has "[MESSAGE-CORE][SEND] Received message:" and Message has targetMessageId
    | project OperationId
    | take 1
    );
let timelineRows = allLogs
    | where isnotempty(targetMessageId)
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Message has targetMessageId
    | extend State = case(
                     Message contains "[MESSAGE-CORE][SEND] Received message",
                     "RECEIVED",
                     Message contains "[MESSAGE-PRODUCER][ENQUEUE] Enqueuing message with ID",
                     "ADD_KAFKA",
                     Message contains "[MESSAGE-SERVICE][PROCESS-MESSAGE] Start processing",
                     "START_PROCESSING",
                     Message contains "[MESSAGE-CORE-PRODUCER-SERVICE][ENQUEUE-MESSAGE]" and Message contains "exceeds max retry attempts",
                     "PROCESSING_FAILED",
                     Message contains "[MESSAGE-CORE-PRODUCER-SERVICE][ENQUEUE-MESSAGE] Enqueuing message ID",
                     "RETRY_PROCESSING",
                     Message contains "[NOTIFY-ERROR-PRODUCER-SERVICE][ENQUEUE-NOTIFY]" and Message contains "exceeds max retry attempts",
                     "RETRY_EXHAUSTED",
                     Message contains "[NOTIFY-ERROR-PRODUCER-SERVICE][ENQUEUE-NOTIFY] Enqueuing message ID",
                     "TRY_SEND_PSP",
                     Message contains "[NOTIFY-SERVICE][GET-TOKEN] Error getting token",
                     "TRY_TOKEN_FAILED",
                     Message contains "[NOTIFY-SERVICE][TO-URL] Failed MsgId",
                     "SENT_FAILED",
                     Message contains "[NOTIFY-SERVICE][TO-URL]" and Message contains "TPP responded",
                     "SENT_SUCCESS",
                     ""
                 )
    | where isnotempty(State)
    | lookup kind=leftouter map on State
    | extend
        Attempt = extract(@"retry attempt:?\s*(\d+)", 1, Message),
        Tpp     = trim_end(@"[.,]", extract(@"(?i)tpp:\s*(\S+)", 1, Message)),
        Reason  = extract(@"Reason:\s*(.*)$", 1, Message)
    | where isempty(targetEntityId) or isempty(Tpp) or Tpp == targetEntityId
    | extend Detail = trim(
                      @"[\s·]+",
                      strcat(
                          iif(isnotempty(Attempt), strcat("Tentativo ", Attempt, " · "), ""),
                          iif(isnotempty(Tpp), strcat("TPP ", Tpp, " · "), ""),
                          Reason
                      )
                  )
    | extend Color = case(Status == "SUCCESS", "#2e9e5b", Status == "FAILURE", "#d9363e", "#1f6fe5")
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Time = format_datetime(TimeGenerated, "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff"),
        State,
        Label,
        Detail,
        Status,
        Color
    | extend IsTimeline = true, IsLog = false;
let logRows = allLogs
    | where isnotempty(targetMessageId)
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where (isnotempty(targetOpId) and OperationId == targetOpId)
        or (Message has "[MESSAGE-CORE-CONSUMER-SERVICE]" and Message has targetMessageId)
        or (Message has "[MESSAGE-SERVICE]" and Message has targetMessageId)
        or (Message has "[MESSAGE-CORE-PRODUCER]" and Message has targetMessageId)
        or (Message has "[MESSAGE-CORE-PRODUCER-SERVICE]" and Message has targetMessageId)
        or (Message has "[NOTIFY-SERVICE]" and Message has targetMessageId)
        or (Message has "[NOTIFY-ERROR-PRODUCER-SERVICE]" and Message has targetMessageId)
        | top 300 by TimeGenerated desc
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Time = format_datetime(TimeGenerated, "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff"),
        LogSeverity = case(SeverityLevel >= 3, "ERROR", SeverityLevel == 2, "WARN", "INFO"),
        LogColor = case(SeverityLevel >= 3, "#d9363e", SeverityLevel == 2, "#e0a100", "#8a8f98"),
        AppRoleName,
        OperationId,
        Message
    | extend IsTimeline = false, IsLog = true;
union timelineRows, logRows
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
